newsitem.title: UK: Shannon air route boom contiuues.
newsitem.headline: Shannon air route boom contiuues.

text.p: AB Shannon, a subsidiary of AB Airlines says that the boom on the London air routes from Shannon International is continuing.
AB Shannon introduced a three times daily air service linking Shannon and London Gatwick in December 1995, in its first year the route carried just over 100,000 passengers.

Managing director Tony Auld said:"Last December we carried twice as many passengers than in the same period in 1995. In January, the trend continued with AB Shannon again doubling the figures from the previous year. Clearly we are making dramatic progress and are now well established as a serious carrier into the west of Ireland." - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
